englishTranslation: Tofu fried with lemongrass and chili
atAGlance: Đậu hũ chiên sả ớt is fried tofu with lemongrass and chili, usually with crisp tofu, sả, chili, garlic, and rice.
whatItIs: Đậu hũ chiên sả ớt is fried tofu tossed with lemongrass, chili, garlic, and savory seasoning. It is crisp-edged, fragrant, and made for rice.
howToEnjoy: Eat with rice so the lemongrass-chili bits season the grains. Ask for less chili if you want the tofu and sả aroma to lead.
howLocalsOrder: Order đậu hũ chiên sả ớt when you want a vegetarian-friendly wok dish, then ask không nước mắm if strict chay seasoning matters.
worthKnowing: Sả ớt gives tofu one of Vietnam’s most recognizable savory aromas: citrusy lemongrass with chili warmth.
goodToKnow: Ask about fish sauce if the tofu is cooked at a mixed rice stall; lemongrass and chili are vegetarian, but seasoning varies.
travelerCaution: Ask about fish sauce if strict.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần đậu hũ chiên sả ớt.
orderLine.english: I’d like one order of tofu fried with lemongrass and chili.
